manifestations.description: Deeply comatose and not responding to verbal stimuli but responding to painful stimuli.
Multiple abrasions of the head, face, body and lower limbs.
Laceration at the dorsum of the right hallux with rupture of the extensor tendon and compound comminuted fracture of the proximal phalanx.
Left sided spastic hemiparesis with dyspraxia.
Poor recent memory (serious memory defects especially for recent events).
Walked with a left foot drop; limping and abnormal gait inclined to the left.
Fine movements of left fingers very poorly executed; great difficulty in extending left fingers from a clenched fist; difficulty in gripping or releasing grip with left hand.
Difficulty in negotiating stairs and sloping ground; more tiring to walk on slopes.
Change in personality and temperament (quarrels easily, acts impulsively, depressed, nightmares).
Unable to participate in active sports, such as swimming, bowling or soccer; social life restricted.

treatments_received: drugs and conservative treatment for compound fracture of right hallux
right frontal and left parietal craniotomies performed on 27th June 1983
treatment for infected contusion of the lung
sutures to puncture wound over anterior triangle of left neck

losses.description: Weakness and lack of co-ordination in left limbs; left sided spastic hemiparesis, left foot drop, and impaired fine movements of left fingers causing difficulty gripping and performing manual tasks.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to participate in active sports such as swimming, bowling or soccer; previously played competitive soccer.
Change in temperament and behaviour: quarrels easily, acts impulsively, depressed, nightmares.
Social life is restricted; does not have a girl-friend though now 23 years of age.
